Solar achieved its highest ever quarterly revenue of ₹400 Cr plus, with volume growth of about 12-14%.

About 70-75% of the 3-wheeler lithium demand is aftermarket retrofitment, where Exide already has a dealer network.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,735.13 Cr (+9.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹215.25 Cr (+15.2% YoY).
Exide Industries Limited’s Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings call audio recording uploaded on 06 May 2026 via website, with no unpublished price-sensitive information shared.
Exide Industries reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹4,735.13 Cr and total lithium-ion subsidiary investment of ₹4,802 Cr.
Exide Industries Limited arranged Q2 FY26-27 earnings call on 5 November 2026 at 12:00 Noon IST, hosted by Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd.
